project-brief.title: Project brief: Eastside Garden Journal
project-brief.bodyMarkdown:
### Project Brief

**Scenario:** The Eastside Community Center needs a clear article page about its neighborhood garden program.

**Your role:** Junior web developer preparing the story for the community website.

**Workspace:** Work in `index.html` and use the live browser preview after each meaningful change.

**Deliverable:** A semantic article page with page landmarks, navigation, article and section structure, complementary information, a logical heading hierarchy, and a meaningful image text alternative.

Build the page in three cumulative steps. Each new step starts from the exact working result of the previous one.
